paragraphs.text: Device mirror, emulator manager, and agent tools for DeepSeek Harness.
# Device Deck
Device Deck is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for device work inside the Harness Web UI.

It starts with an Android device mirror, then grows into one control surface for
Android, iOS, and W
eb devices, with the agent able to inspect and drive them.

> Status: alpha (`0.1.0`). The Android mirror is usable. iOS and Web mirroring
> and AI E2E testing

.1.0`). The Android mirror is usable. iOS and Web mirroring
> and AI E2E testing are on the roadmap.
## Features
### Available now

- **Device menu in the Session header.** One click lists running devices,
stopped Android AVDs, and

iOS simulators, and pairs wireless ADB devices.
- **Android mirror.** scrcpy video decoded with WebC

odecs in the page.
- **Direct control.** Tap, swipe, back, home, text input, and open URL or deep
li

nk.
- **Android AVD management.** List AVDs, start them headless, stop them, and
open the mirror onc

e they are ready.
- **iOS simulator management.** List simulators, boot and shut down them, and
open

the Simulator app. Screen mirroring is not implemented yet.
- **Wireless ADB.** Connect a device wi

th `host` or `host:port`.
- **Screenshots.** Save the current screen, browse the latest shots, and s

end a
shot to the current chat.
- **Agent tool.** `device_screenshot` returns the selected screensho

t as an
image.
- **Shortcut.** `Ctrl+M` opens or closes the mirror.
## Roadmap

- Web page preview and control.
- iOS simulator mirroring.
- AI E2E testing: plan, act, wait, and as

sert against a device or page.
- Test recording and replay.
- Multi-device decks.
Roadmap items are not implemented. Do not treat them as available features.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with plugin support.
- Node.js 20 or newer for the Host half.
- `adb` from Androi

d platform-tools for Android devices.
- Android SDK `emulator` for AVD management.
- Xcode command-l
ine tools for iOS simulators, on macOS.

The bundle ships `scrcpy-server` 3.3.3, so a separate scrcpy install is not
required.

ere after dependency changes.
## Usage

1. Open a Session.
2. Click the device icon in the Session header, at the top right.
3. Pick a runni

ng Android device to open its mirror, or start a stopped AVD.
4. In the mirror, use the left rail fo

r back, home, text, and links.
5. Use the title bar for screenshots, reconnect, and minimize.
6. Sel
ect a screenshot, then send it to the current chat.
Wireless ADB:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
A bare host is accepted; port `5555` is added automatically.
## How it works

- The Host half registers `/api/device-deck/*` routes and starts one scrcpy
session per Android devi

ce.
- Video packets travel over same-origin chunked HTTP and are decoded with
WebCodecs.
- The Clien

t half registers into the Session header and renders the device menu
and the floating mirror.
- Scre

enshots live under `~/.dsh/device-deck/screenshots`. The newest 30 per
device are kept; the selected

screenshot is never removed.
- The plugin keeps no cloud service. Device commands go to local `adb`

or
`xcrun`. Screenshots go to the current chat only when you send them.
## Limitations

- The mirror is Android only.
- H.264 only. H.265 devices show an error.
- Text input uses `adb shel

l input text`, so it accepts ASCII only.
- One device is mirrored at a time.
- iOS simulators are li

sted and controlled, but not mirrored.
- Web devices are not supported yet.

| `client.js` | Client plugin:

header menu, mirror, WebCodecs |
| `bin/scrcpy-server` | Bundled scrcpy server 3.3.3 |
| `cordis.pat

ch.yml` | Bundle patch |
| `locale/` | Plugin Manager titles and descriptions |
